problem: Windows full Release build failed to link ABI ownership and interpreter tests: runtime execution lock/depth/acquired definitions are in a /GL static component and absent from automatic DLL exports
change: Add an MSVC 64-bit module-definition input exporting the three shared execution-guard functions; retain all compiler/optimization settings and the existing guard implementation
build_method: Original sibling main source remained unchanged. Its existing incremental build used CMAKE_PROJECT_xlang3_INCLUDE with a deferred target_sources call adding the isolated branch's .def, equivalent to the branch CMake target_sources addition. No replacement guard implementation or separate test lock was introduced.

performance.baseline: Preserved pre-export-change Release executable/DLL at the same main revision. This comparison does not replace historical accepted baselines or establish historical performance recovery.

interpreter_policy_correction.incident: Initial unfiltered 58-test run mistakenly executed the legacy pickle wrapper, which launched CPython internally. That run is not an xlang3-only acceptance result; original log retained in xMind .agentflow/blockers-20261102/xlang3-all-tests.log.
interpreter_policy_correction.guard: Windows CMake registers pickle interoperability only when XLANG3_PYTHON314_EXECUTABLE is configured, and passes the exact oracle path. Wrapper rejects omitted/nonabsolute/missing oracle paths instead of searching for CPython.
interpreter_policy_correction.guard_validation: Omitted oracle rejected before either interpreter launch or workspace creation. Incremental overlay disables legacy registration when the interpreter variable is empty; permitted 57-test rerun explicitly excludes it.

limits: Windows x64 Release build/export/test compatibility only. No new installed xMind release or full model-backed xMind acceptance. SDK/runtime source semantics, IPC and optimization levels remain unchanged.
